# Courses, training and their materials {.display-name}

::: {.lede}
Five years of MSc statistics and econometrics at Justus Liebig University Giessen;
week-long courses that hand fiscal incidence microsimulation and poverty mapping over
to the finance ministries and national statistical offices that have to run them; and
the World Bank's own course on AI-assisted coding. Every course was taught in R, and
each entry below says what was written for it — slides, worked exercises, downloadable
projects, recordings — cohort by cohort, and where it lives.
:::
:::

## Reusing the materials {.split}

The course sites are published so that students can return to them after the course
and other instructors can build on them. Every site has its source repository beside
it, holding the slide decks, the exercises and the data they use. Reuse or adapt any
of it with credit and a link back to this site. Where a repository is still private,
the entry above says so, and its addresses will start working when it is opened.
